    private function getRecords($request)\n
    {\n
        $column = $request->input('column');\n
        $value = $request->input('value');\n
        $query = Quotation::query();\n
\n
        $form = json_decode($request->form ?: '{}');\n
        // Vista unificada por defecto: empresa + tienda virtual (distinción vía source / badges)\n
        $source = $form->source ?? 'all';\n
\n
        if ($source === 'ecommerce') {\n
            $query->whereSourceEcommerce();\n
        } elseif ($source === 'admin') {\n
            $query->whereSourceAdmin();\n
        }\n
        // source === 'all' → sin filtro de origen\n
\n
        if ($column === 'user_name') {\n
            $query->whereHas('user', function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            })\n
                ->whereTypeUser();\n
        } else if ($column === 'customer') {\n
            $query->whereHas('person', function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$value}%")\n
                    ->orWhere('number', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            })\n
                ->whereTypeUser();\n
\n
        } else if ($column === 'seller_name') {\n
            $query->whereHas('seller', function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            });\n
        } else if ($column === 'observations') {\n
            if (!is_null($value) && $value !== '') {\n
                $query->where('description', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            }\n
        } else if ($column === 'number') {\n
            if (!is_null($value) && $value !== '') {\n
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                    $q->where('id', $value)\n
                        ->orWhere('number', $value);\n
                });\n
            }\n
        } else {\n
            $query->where($column, 'like', "%{$value}%")\n
                ->whereTypeUser();\n
        }\n
\n
        $records = $query->latest();\n
\n
        if (! empty($form->date_start) && ! empty($form->date_end)) {\n
            $records = $records->whereBetween('date_of_issue', [$form->date_start, $form->date_end]);\n
        }\n
\n
        $state_type_id = $form->state_type_id ?? null;\n
        if ($state_type_id) $records->where('state_type_id', $state_type_id);\n
\n
        return $records;\n
    }\n

    public function duplicate(Request $request)\n
    {\n
        // ######## INICIO CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
        DB::connection('tenant')->transaction(function () use ($request) {\n
            $obj = Quotation::withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);\n
            $this->quotation = $obj->replicate();\n
            $this->quotation->external_id = Str::uuid()->toString();\n
            $this->quotation->state_type_id = '01';\n
            $this->quotation->prepayments = [];\n
            $this->quotation->total_prepayment = '0';\n
            $this->quotation->discounts = array_values(array_filter((array) ($obj->discounts ?? []),\n
                fn ($row) => !in_array(data_get($row, 'discount_type_id'), ['04','05'], true)));\n
            $this->quotation->save();\n
\n
            \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($this->quotation, function () use ($obj) {\n
                foreach ($obj->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get() as $row) {\n
                    $new = $row->replicate();\n
                    $new->quotation_id = $this->quotation->id;\n
                    $new->save();\n
                    $snapshot = $row->calculation_snapshot;\n
                    if ($snapshot) {\n
                        $new->setExactValues(array_intersect_key($snapshot['values'], array_flip(\App\Support\Exact\Persistence::columns($new))));\n
                        $new->calculation_snapshot = $snapshot;\n
                        $new->saveQuietly();\n
                    }\n
                }\n
            });\n
            $this->quotation->refresh();\n
            $this->setFilename();\n
        });\n
        // ######## FIN CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
\n
        return [\n

    /** Keep previously recorded movements and their frozen currency details intact. */\n
    private function syncExistingPayments($quotation, array $payments, $previousCurrency, array $items): void\n
    {\n
        // ######## INICIO MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
        $new = \App\Services\Payments\ExistingReceipts::synchronize($quotation, $payments, $previousCurrency);\n
        $quotation->save();\n
        if ($items) {\n
            \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($quotation, function () use ($quotation, $items) {\n
                // ######## INICIO CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
                // Reutilizar las partidas propias para preservar los operandos exactos\n
                // que no cambiaron; el snapshot recibido del cliente no es autoridad.\n
                $stored = $quotation->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');\n
                $kept = [];\n
                foreach ($items as $row) {\n
                    $id = $row['id'] ?? null;\n
                    foreach (['price_input', 'quantity_input'] as $field) {\n
                        if (($row[$field] ?? null) === null) unset($row[$field]);\n
                    }\n
                    unset($row['calculation_snapshot'], $row['quotation_id']);\n
                    if ($id !== null && $id !== '') {\n
                        if (!$stored->has($id) || isset($kept[(string) $id])) {\n
                            \App\Services\Fiscal\FiscalAmounts::error('items', 'La partida no pertenece a esta cotización o está repetida.');\n
                        }\n
                        $line = $stored->get($id);\n
                        unset($row['id']);\n
                        $line->fill($row);\n
                        $line->save();\n
                        $kept[(string) $id] = true;\n
                    } else {\n
                        unset($row['id']);\n
                        $line = $quotation->items()->create($row);\n
                        $kept[(string) $line->id] = true;\n
                    }\n
                }\n
                $quotation->items()->whereNotIn('id', array_keys($kept))->delete();\n
                // ######## FIN CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
            });\n
        } else {\n
            $quotation->items()->delete();\n
        }\n
        if (\App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::values($quotation, false, true)['total_difference']->isNegative()) {\n
            \App\Services\Payments\Classification::error('total', 'El total no puede ser menor que los cobros aplicados.');\n
        }\n
        $this->savePayments($quotation, $new);\n
        // ######## FIN MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
    }\n

    /**\n
     * Actualiza cantidades, precios y descuentos %, recalcula IGV/totales y regenera PDF.\n
     * Los ítems quedan listos para generar Factura/Boleta/NV con los mismos valores.\n
     */\n
    public function updatePrices(Request $request)\n
    {\n
        $request->validate([\n
            'id' => 'required|integer',\n
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1',\n
            'items.*.id' => 'required|integer',\n
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',\n
            'items.*.unit_price' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',\n
            'items.*.discount_percentage' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',\n
        ]);\n
\n
        try {\n
            $quotation = null;\n
\n
            DB::connection('tenant')->transaction(function () use ($request, &$quotation) {\n
                $quotation = Quotation::with('items')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->input('id'));\n
\n
                if (! $quotation->isFromEcommerce()) {\n
                    throw new Exception('Solo se pueden confirmar precios en cotizaciones de tienda virtual.');\n
                }\n
\n
                if ((string) $quotation->state_type_id === '11') {\n
                    throw new Exception('No se puede modificar una cotización anulada.');\n
                }\n
\n
                if ($quotation->documents()->exists()) {\n
                    throw new Exception('La cotización ya tiene comprobantes asociados.');\n
                }\n
\n
                $submitted = collect($request->input('items'));\n
                $stored = $quotation->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');\n
                $ids = $submitted->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id) => (string) $id);\n
                if ($ids->unique()->count() !== $ids->count() || $ids->count() !== $stored->count()\n
                    || $ids->contains(fn ($id) => !$stored->has($id))) {\n
                    throw new Exception('Las partidas deben pertenecer a esta cotización y no pueden repetirse.');\n
                }\n
                \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($quotation, function () use ($submitted, $stored) {\n
                    foreach ($submitted as $payload) {\n
                        $row = $stored->get($payload['id']);\n
                        if (!in_array($row->affectation_igv_type_id, ['10', '20', 'EXP'], true)) {\n
                            throw new Exception('Esta partida requiere una afectación de IVA vigente.');\n
                        }\n
                        $quantity = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::input($payload['quantity'], 'items.quantity');\n
                        $unitPrice = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::input($payload['unit_price'], 'items.unit_price');\n
                        $percentage = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::input($payload['discount_percentage'] ?? '0', 'items.discount_percentage');\n
                        $pct = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($percentage);\n
                        if (\App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($quantity)->isLessThanOrEqualTo(0)\n
                            || \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($unitPrice)->isLessThanOrEqualTo(0)\n
                            || $pct->isNegative() || $pct->isGreaterThan(100)) {\n
                            throw new Exception('Cantidad, precio o descuento inválido.');\n
                        }\n
                        $rawDiscounts = $row->getAttributes()['discounts'] ?? null;\n
                        $discounts = $rawDiscounts ? \App\Support\Exact\JsonDecimals::decode($rawDiscounts) : [];\n
                        $editable = [];\n
                        foreach ($discounts as $index => $discount) {\n
                            $discount = (array) $discount;\n
                            if (($discount['discount_type_id'] ?? '') === '00' && empty($discount['from_global_distribution'])) $editable[] = $index;\n
                        }\n
                        if (count($editable) > 1 || ($editable && !empty(((array)$discounts[$editable[0]])['is_amount']))) {\n
                            throw new Exception('Esta partida tiene descuentos que requieren la edición completa.');\n
                        }\n
                        $old = $editable ? (array)$discounts[$editable[0]] : null;\n
                        $oldPercentage = $old ? (isset($old['percentage']) ? \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($old['percentage'])\n
                            : \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::inputRational($old['factor'] ?? '0')->multipliedBy(100)) : \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of(0);\n
                        if (!$oldPercentage->isEqualTo($pct)) {\n
                            if ($editable) unset($discounts[$editable[0]]);\n
                            if (!$pct->isZero()) $discounts[] = ['discount_type_id'=>'00','description'=>'Descuento',\n
                                'percentage'=>\App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($pct),'is_amount'=>false];\n
                            $row->discounts = array_values($discounts);\n
                        }\n
                        foreach (['quantity'=>$quantity, 'unit_price'=>$unitPrice] as $field=>$value) {\n
                            if (\App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue($field)) !== \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($value)) $row->$field = $value;\n
                        }\n
                        $item = \App\Support\Exact\JsonDecimals::decode($row->getAttributes()['item'] ?? '{}');\n
                        $item['sale_unit_price'] = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($unitPrice);\n
                        $item['unit_price'] = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($unitPrice);\n
                        $item['prices_pending'] = false;\n
                        $row->item = $item;\n
                        $row->save();\n
                    }\n
                });\n
                if (\App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::values($quotation, false, true)['total_difference']->isNegative()) {\n
                    throw new Exception('El total no puede ser menor que los cobros aplicados.');\n
                }\n
            });\n
\n
            try {\n
                if ($quotation && $quotation->filename) {\n
                    $this->createPdf($quotation->fresh(['items', 'user', 'fiscal_environment_type', 'state_type', 'currency_type']), 'a4', $quotation->filename);\n
                }\n
            } catch (Exception $pdfError) {\n
                // Los precios ya se guardaron; el PDF puede regenerarse luego.\n
            }\n
\n
            $fresh = $quotation->fresh();\n
\n
            return [\n
                'success' => true,\n
                'message' => 'Cotización actualizada correctamente.',\n
                'data' => [\n
                    'id' => $fresh->id,\n
                    'total' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($fresh->exactValue('total')),\n
                    'total_discount' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($fresh->exactValue('total_discount')),\n
                    'needs_price_confirmation' => $fresh->needsPriceConfirmation(),\n
                ],\n
            ];\n
        } catch (Exception $e) {\n
            return [\n
                'success' => false,\n
                'message' => $e->getMessage(),\n
            ];\n
        }\n
    }\n

    /**\n
     * Extrae el % de descuento de ítem desde el JSON discounts (tipo 00).\n
     *\n
     * @param  mixed  $discounts\n
     */\n
    private function extractItemDiscountPercentage($discounts): string\n
    {\n
        foreach ($discounts as $entry) {\n
            $row = (array) $entry;\n
